item.title: Judge rules Trump administration must keep funding child care subsidies in 5 states for now
item.description: (AP) — A federal judge ruled Friday that President Donald Trump’s administration must keep federal funds flowing to child care subsidies and other social service programs in five Democratic-controlled states — at least for now. The ruling Friday from U.S. District Judge Vernon Broderick extends by two weeks a temporary one issued earlier this month […]

item.title: Indiana National Guard deploys 110 personnel ahead of snowstorm
item.description: The Indiana National Guard is deploying 110 soldiers and airmen in 12 highway assistance teams to help stranded drivers in southern Indiana.

item.title: Finley Bizjack’s 28-point performance lifts Butler past Marquette
item.description: Butler defeated Marquette 87-76 on Friday, led by Finley Bizjack's 28 points and Michael Ajayi's 17 points.

item.title: Hoosiers’ 3-point barrage leads to victory over Rutgers
item.description: Indiana defeated Rutgers 82-59 on Friday night, ending a four-game losing streak, with Lamar Wilkerson, Nick Dorn, and Tucker DeVries combining for 72 points.

item.title: Fernando Mendoza declares for the NFL draft
item.description: Indiana University quarterback Fernando Mendoza has declared for the 2026 NFL Draft, and is projected by ESPN analyst Mel Kiper Jr. to be the No. 1 overall pick.

item.title: Lafayette police arrest five in shooting of Judge Steve Meyer and his wife
item.description: Five people have been arrested in connection to the shooting of a Tippecanoe County judge and his wife, with the investigation involving authorities in multiple states and assistance from the FBI and federal marshals.

item.title: Indianapolis police help evacuate business building engulfed in flames
item.description: Indianapolis firefighters battled a large blaze at a building with a body shop, a tire shop, and an auto dealership on Friday night. Indianapolis police helped to evacuate workers, four of whom were treated for smoke inhalation.

item.title: Weekend winter storm ahead with bitter temperatures in the mix | Jan. 23, 2026
item.description: Central Indiana is expecting a weekend winter storm that could potentially drop several inches of snow, causing heightened travel impacts, with the bulk of the snow accumulation happening Sunday morning into the evening.
